target_customer: Mechanical engineers using CAD software such as SolidWorks and Onshape
problem: Parametric CAD modeling is slow and manual; engineers want to create and query models in plain language.
business_model: Subscription CAD plugin; one directory lists from 49 dollars per month, unconfirmed

founders.name: Arya Bastani
founders.background_notes: Trained transformer models on EEG data in Berkeley BLISS Lab per YC page.

founders.background_notes: Helped launch Amazon Q per YC page.

founders.background_notes: Worked on ads at Meta per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating valid parametric feature trees inside commercial CAD needs plugin integration and models that understand geometry, which was research grade in 2024.

defensibility.rationale: Specialized CAD models and plugin integration help, but CAD vendors and other startups could build copilots.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Other CAD copilots such as Leo AI and Adam were listed as competitors in undated directory pages; no incumbent action verified.

market_need_then: Show HN framed the product as like Cursor for CAD; no dated demand figures found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Engineer focused, Cursor for CAD framing

branding.brand_signature: Like Cursor for CAD tagline in Show HN
branding.community_and_virality: Show HN thread; the team says it won YC internal demo day and an OpenAI o1 hackathon (self reported).

brand_strength.rationale: The name appears to echo the CAD term chamfer but no source confirms it; brand press is limited to launch posts.

outcome_analysis: Camfer is flagged inactive by YC but its site is live with free use, 2025 job listings exist and no shutdown was found. It is likely still operating, so the inactive flag looks stale. Funding detail is thin and conflicts across aggregators.
notes: YC status Inactive conflicts with a live site and a search summary calling the YC profile active.
